body: The request slip lies in my hand, its stamped "REFUSED" a stark contradiction to the warmth and support that my protective instincts urge me to provide. My eyes scan the slip, my mind racing with the implications of this rejection. I feel a pang of disappointment, but it's not enough to shake my resolve.
